summary: Hook waiver/allow-arm spoofed by trailing same-clause comment text: 5 destructive working-tree shapes exit 0 while bash executes them; sibling FP blocks a clean dry-run
evidence: epm:code-review-codex v1 Critical + reconciler epm:review-reconcile v1 Findings table row 1: guard_repo_root_branch.sh:414 (-C waiver matches comment tail, waives whole clause) and :253-258 (restore allow-arm reads comment-tail staged flag). Reconciler replay vs worktree hook: restore-dot / checkout-dot / clean -fd / reset --hard each with a '# ... -C ...' or '# --staged' tail -> rc=0; 'clean -n # -f' -> rc=2 (FP). Fix: strip/delimit unquoted whitespace-anchored comment tails before waiver+classification (NO full quote-strip pre-pass, #796) or anchor the -C waiver at clause start; add the 6 permanent hook test rows Codex enumerated.

summary: Doc-lint restore exemption lookahead scans the whole physical line, so a fenced destructive restore line with a comment-tail staged flag is not flagged
evidence: epm:code-review-codex v1 Major: workflow_lint.py:3878 pattern (?![^`]*--staged) — reconciler regex probe confirmed no match on the fenced comment-tail shape. Prescriptive-only (runtime hook is the tooth once the BLOCKER lands) hence CONCERN not BLOCKER. Fix: bound the exemption scan at an unquoted comment start or restrict to actual restore arguments; add the lint test Codex sketched.

summary: Hook header claims tight-anchor immunity for prose inside -m strings, but the bare-pathspec existence probe rides the legacy loose anchor and trips on commit-message prose naming a real path
evidence: epm:code-review v1 Minor 1: header :60-64 vs probe :353-361; reconciler replay: a commit -m string containing 'checkout CLAUDE.md' -> rc=2 (fails closed). Fix: one header sentence naming the loose-anchor prose-FP class + optional expect-2 test row.

summary: Absolute-path bare pathspec inside the repo evades the existence probe (fail-open) and is missing from the header residual-gap list
evidence: epm:code-review v1 Minor 2: guard_repo_root_branch.sh:73-93 residual list has no item for it; probe legs cat-file HEAD:/abs and [ -e REPO//abs ] both mis-resolve. Reconciler replay: checkout of the repo's absolute CLAUDE.md path -> rc=0 while git would revert the file. Fix: name as residual item (vii) or strip a REPO/ prefix from arg before probing.
